$comment: What npm metadata cannot say about what Studio ships (#1612). Read by scripts/generate-licences.mjs; every entry says why it is here.

dompurify.reason: Dual-licensed; Studio takes it under Apache-2.0.

json-schema.reason: Dual-licensed; Studio takes it under BSD-3-Clause.

elkjs.reason: Dual-licensed; Studio takes it under EPL-2.0, whose source is at the repository below. Bundled through mermaid for graph layout.

khroma.reason: Its package.json has no license field; the licence file it ships is MIT.

remark-math.reason: Ships no licence file; package.json says MIT.

@defasm/core.reason: Ships no licence file; package.json says ISC and names Defectus as its author.

@ai-sdk/provider-utils.reason: Ships no licence file; package.json says Apache-2.0. Part of the Vercel AI SDK.

node-pty.reason: Carries winpty for Windows, under its own licence in a subfolder.

pg-types.reason: Ships no licence file; package.json says MIT and names its author. Bundled into the PostgreSQL plugin (through pg).

pgpass.reason: Ships no licence file; package.json says MIT and names its author. Bundled into the PostgreSQL plugin (through pg).

proxy-agent-negotiate.reason: Ships no licence file; package.json says MIT and names its author. Bundled into the SQL Server plugin (through tedious).

include.name: monaco-editor
include.reason: Copied into the app whole as an asset (min/vs), so the bundle does not list it. Its ThirdPartyNotices.txt covers the code it carries from others; the codicon font is listed separately.

components.name: Chromium, Node.js, V8, FFmpeg and their dependencies
components.notice: Electron carries Chromium, Node.js, V8 and FFmpeg. Their licences, and those of everything they include, are in LICENSES.chromium.html, which is installed with the application.
components.accepted: Not one licence: Electron's own credits file lists each, installed with the app.

components.name: Codicons
components.accepted: Icon font: CC BY 4.0 asks only for attribution, which this notice gives.
components.notice: The codicon icon font, embedded in Monaco's stylesheet, is Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation and is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International licence: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

components.name: ripgrep
components.notice: The rg executable in @vscode/ripgrep is ripgrep, dual-licensed under MIT or the Unlicense; Studio takes it under MIT.

components.name: ConPTY (Windows)
components.notice: node-pty carries Microsoft's ConPTY binaries (third_party/conpty) for terminals on Windows.

components.name: Hero Patterns
components.unverified: Credited as MIT, (c) 2016 Alec Lomas, in _textures.scss; heropatterns.com may say CC BY 4.0 by Steve Schoger. To be confirmed in #1613.
